κατουρ-ίζω ,
A.bring into port with a fair wind, metaph., bring safe to port, bring to fulfilment, τάδ᾽ ὀρθῶς ἔμπεδα κατουρίζει (sc. the oracle), or (as others) intr., these things come to fulfilment, S. Tr. 827 (lyr.).
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
